turns.teacher: Good morning children. Sit properly, ekdam chup. Today we do subtraction. Fifty two minus twenty seven. Write in copy.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Rabi, what you wrote? Thirty five? No no, galat hai. Wrong. Next.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Answer is twenty five. Fifty two minus twenty seven is twenty five. All of you say it, twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Arjoon, again thirty five? I told na. Two is small, so take ten from five. Two becomes twelve. Twelve minus seven is five. Four minus two is two. Listen properly, are baba!
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Ok, now next one. Sixty one minus thirty four. Do fast, jaldi jaldi.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Mina, you are counting on fingers again? Stop that, ka kar rahi ho. Answer is twenty seven. Write twenty seven.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Everybody got twenty seven? Thumbs up who got it. Hmm, ok. Close copies.
turns.label: check_whole_class
